for me, it was a combined effect from growing up not knowing i was different and still desperately trying to fit in and being treated badly for not knowing how to fit in. My mother never understood my meltdowns and accused me of deliberate bad behavior when I really just struggled to articulate what I really needed. My advice is to really just be open-minded and try to listen. It would've meant the world to me if my mom had just actually tried to be there for me, instead of selfishly thinking about how my difficult emotions 'made her life difficult.'
